name: obby worst case (kit-b B1): every far + sea cloud of a course in view, 40 platform puffs, 6 pads, 2 storm steps, 16 players x 3 pets
doc: py -3.12 tools/mesh_budget.py --scene blender/scenes/obby_view.json --check. CourseLayout makes 14-22 far puffs and 6-10 sea puffs per course (all counted, though a phone sees about half); 40 platform puffs (Easy l / m, Medium s) and 6 pads (Start, 4 checkpoints, Finish) is more than a 15-platform Easy view holds; each Storm step wears 3 obby_storm_cloud anchors (CourseBuilder Mesh.storm). Parts: the proposed contract 6.5 budget of tools/mesh_budget.py (PART_BUDGET instances 3000; the old 400 is over in the lobby scene too); the clouds add 84 MeshParts, the 48 pets 1506.
